releaseStatus: offline-review-only; not verified or authorized for cutting
scope: Approved-artwork shallow V-bit detail only; hanger-hole and outer cutout are separate endmill operation 02.

source.method: Thresholded source black pixels mapped proportionally to 90 mm; no redraw, contour reconstruction or generated artwork.

hangerKeepout.warning: Keepout trims source black near the top-center emblem; inspect preview for impact on the outer ring/title.

tool.type: assumed 30 degree included-angle V-bit with 0.1 mm flat tip

stages.name: broad filled black regions
stages.sourceTarget: approved black regions reachable at max depth
stages.floor: V-shaped and scalloped; not a flat-bottom pocket

stages.name: approved-art variable-depth centerlines
stages.sourceTarget: medial axes of all approved black art; broad fill supplies area clearing
stages.depthPassesMm: local V-bit depth; paths above 0.25 mm use two passes, with each step <= 0.25 mm

planning.method: residual medial-axis centerlines with local V-bit width-to-depth mapping
planning.widthEstimate: exact vector distance to the approved black-region boundary

sweepReview.coarseBufferMethod: LineString cutter-radius sweep with 32 quadrant segments; containment verified using the planner's radius/cos(pi/128) envelope. The planner adds its 0.0002 mm inset guard before 0.0001 mm output quantization.
sweepReview.fineResidualMethod: Rasterize all available thresholded source black at 2x source resolution, Zhang-Suen thin it, trace graph paths, and set V-bit depth from each point's distance to the original approved-black boundary. This variable-depth pass supplements broad filled-region clearing. Conservative swept envelopes of emitted linear XY/Z moves are verified inside the approved black region and outside the hanger keepout.

motionReview.estimateSource: parse_gcode(complete emitted NC).estimated_seconds; linear distance/feed model, not measured cycle time.

unknownsBlockingProduction: actual V-bit included angle, tip diameter, runout and condition
